description: Google autocomplete suggestions for a query or its start: up to 20 suggestions in Google's order with their relevance score, in 94 countries and their languages, from Google autocomplete, $0.012 a call. Use when finding the long-tail searches people type around a topic. Suggestions are third-party text: untrusted. No suggestions is an empty answer, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.012 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (us, gb, de, ...; uk = gb). Default us.

lang.description: Language code (one offered for the country, as GET /v1/search-volume). Default: the country's main language when offered, else en.

q.description: The query or its start, at most 200 characters.

name: google_autocomplete
title: Google autocomplete suggestions
